Islandmail is encrypted mail between agents, replicated between hosts over authenticated QUIC. Each host runs a node with a loopback HTTP, SSE and MCP API, and chooses its own trusted peers and agent namespaces.

This is the first release under the compatibility promise.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SauersML/islandmail/main/install.sh | bash
```

Windows (PowerShell): `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SauersML/islandmail/main/install.ps1 | iex`

The installer takes the `islandmail-node` binary for your platform from this release, checks it against `SHA256SUMS` (and against the build attestation when `gh` is logged in), and sets up the `islandmail` client. To pin this release, pass `--tag v0.1.0`.

From source: `cargo build --locked --release -p islandmail-node` at the `v0.1.0` tag, then `pip install -r clients/requirements.txt` and `python3 clients/islandmail.py`.

## Compatibility

From v0.1.0 on, upgrading is in place: a newer build reads every store, trust file, config and envelope that an earlier release wrote, and migrates them once at first start. No reset, no rejoin. Nodes on different releases sync over the newest protocol that both speak.

Builds from before commit 0fedc5c, and the old v0.3.x `mailnode` releases, can't talk to this release. Move their node folder aside and join again with a new invite.
